# Fixtures

`librispeech_1272-128104-0003.wav` / `.txt`: one utterance (9.9 s, 16 kHz mono PCM16) from the
LibriSpeech dev-clean set (speaker 1272, chapter 128104), taken via the
`hf-internal-testing/librispeech_asr_dummy` dataset. The `.txt` is the reference transcript
(upper case, no punctuation, as in LibriSpeech).

LibriSpeech is licensed CC BY 4.0: Panayotov, Chen, Povey, Khudanpur, "LibriSpeech: an ASR
corpus based on public domain audio books", ICASSP 2015.
